name: Fringe
summary: Volume and brightness from your trackpad's edges
description:
Fringe turns the edges of your trackpad into sliders. Start a one-finger drag in a corner and slide along the edge: the left edge sets the volume, the right edge the display brightness and the top edge the keyboard backlight, with a click from the Force Touch trackpad at every step and Droppy's own HUD in the notch.

Fringe only listens to the trackpad and never blocks a touch. A resting palm or a second finger never counts, a drag that wanders into the middle stops, and you can ask for a key to be held while you drag. Each edge can do something else or nothing at all, and the shelf widget pauses everything in one click.
